text:
Adrienne: Heads up — need a small set of launch assets for next week's webinar: 3 performance snapshot tiles (web + 1:1 social), one 16:9 slide diagram of inbound routing, and a simplified one-pager for AE handoff. Can design take this?
Marc: Yep, we can. Can you drop the benchmark numbers and the topline copy? Also what's the primary CTA and target audience?
Adrienne: Pushed dataset + copy in the doc: https://redwood.docs/perf-launch (see ‘Snapshot copy’ tab). CTA is Register -> Schedule demo. Audience = platform/product leads. Emphasize latency vs unit cost.
Sara (Design): Quick Q: Do tiles need co-brand with partner CloudX? If so, do we have the partner lockup and spacing rules?
Adrienne: Partner logo only on the webinar landing and one of the tiles (CloudX). Use partner-approved lockup from Figma. Brand rules: follow `Brand/lockups/partner-guidelines` — no color swaps.
Marc: For the routing slide: want three lanes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) with arrows showing fallbacks and a small inset showing autoscale + cache callouts. I sketched a low-fi wire in the doc.
Eli: Also need export variants: email header (600x200), social card (1200x627), hero tile (1600x640), thumbnail (400x200). Can we get retina @2x for high-dpi?
Sara (Design): Yes — will export @1x and @2x. Color/palette question: stick to primary brand palette, avoid neon. Any copy edits I should push?
Adrienne: Keep copy short — 2 lines max on tiles. Use this headline: “Inference that scales — predictably.” Body line: “Reduce latency and per-token cost across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.”
Sara (Design): Good. I'll post a Figma prototype link here when the first pass is up. ETA end of day tomorrow.
Nina: Heads-up from Legal — if we use CloudX logo, we need a signed co-marketing approval before publishing. Adrienne, can you confirm?
Adrienne: Confirmed — marketing has the approval email thread. I'll attach the PDF before assets go live.
Sara (Design): Draft assets uploaded: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/redwood-perf-tiles — ping me for access. Export naming convention:```
perf-tile_{variant}_{size}_v1.png
slide-routing_v1_16x9.pdf
onepager_webinar_v1.pdf```
Marc: Perfect. Please also include a version with minimal copy for the webinar registration page (tile variant: `reg-minimal`).
Design-Bot: automated export complete: perf-tile_web_1600x640_v1.png, perf-tile_social_1200x627_v1.png uploaded to /shared/marketing/assets/3724689123/
Eli: :thumbsup: Sara — once you upload final zips, drop them here and I'll update the webinar landing + Pardot email templates.
Sara (Design): Will do. Posting a quick visual check request — @Adrienne @Marc please review tiles for brand + messaging before EOD tomorrow. :eyes:
Adrienne: Will review. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
